scope: Explicit source121..150 names/descriptions; preserve prior120. Eight-cell names, nine-cell description rows, source controls and numerals protected.
reference: EXE3 common names are unapproved candidates. Trap descriptions specify the enemy triggering self-damage, not the player.
terminology_review: エレメントリーフ -> 엘리먼트리프
エレメントサンド -> 엘리먼트샌드
ブラインド -> 블라인드 / 암흑 상태
Trap140..143: enemy attack triggers damage to that enemy; wording needs review
